method: Two papers per cohort selected by fixed ID hash. Second grader did not see first grade. Root adjudicated source discoveries and claim-scope conflicts before fitting. No true/false conflict is hidden by reporting only binary overlap; the full state confusion is shown.
limitations: Six papers cannot establish general label reliability.
Known-versus-unknown disagreements show substantial search-coverage sensitivity.
Replications often test only one component of a broader paper.
